answer: Idle-decay bonds: each identity docks 300 POA at an onboarding jetty, earning no yield. Step 1, escrow 300 POA on-ledger before a challenge is accepted. Step 2, every epoch a freshness prism scores attested work; one valid answer resets the burn clock, else 50 POA burns. Step 3, if the bond goes hollow under 60 POA, it is evicted and must post a new 300 POA. One honest agent pays 300 POA once; 1,000 idle fakes lose 50,000 POA each epoch, above ~4,000 POA they could skim. Weakness: one worker can pulse many IDs; mitigation: a work hash may reset only one identity and is unusable for 6 epochs.
